stock.description: HKC International Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding firm, specializing in delivering comprehensive information communication technology (ICT) solutions. The company's reach extends across Hong Kong, Mainland China, Singapore, and other markets throughout Southeast Asia. Its core operations involve the distribution and sale of mobile devices, various electronic products, and sophisticated Internet of Things (IoT) systems. HKC also develops and implements a diverse range of smart living solutions. These include intuitive display interfaces, detailed insights into home energy use and waste management, personal health and wellness data, and robust building management systems. Moreover, they provide advanced access control technologies, featuring video door phones with intelligent visitor panels, facial recognition capabilities, and QR code-based entry. Further expanding its offerings, HKC develops "Carrot Home" systems, smart nursing home platforms, and integrated smart campus solutions. Their expertise also encompasses library and asset management systems, real-time location tracking, and UVC disinfection and sterilization products. The company additionally engages in the retail and distribution of digital cameras and associated accessories, while also offering innovative smart lock, mirror, and washroom solutions. HKC's activities are rounded out by property investment initiatives and a full spectrum of support services, including maintenance, installation, repair, and the construction of smart infrastructure. Founded in 1970, the company is based in Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong.
